title: Team Fortress Team Fight Tactics: A love letter to my two favorite games
author: theahura1
selftext:
Give the game a spin at [tftft.com](http://tftft.com) \-- planning to add more game modes, maps, and a ranked mode now that the basic game is in beta.

Sharing a bit more about the workflow for how this game was developed, since I suspect folks here are interested in that sort of thing.

All AI agents were running in the cloud. The game was built on a Claude Max and a Codex Max sub (though I never really hit token limits on either). Claude Opus 5.5 drove most of the high level thinking, and there was a swarm of Opus 5.5. and Codex Astra agents to do the implementation.

Opus was primarily used for code. Codex was primarily used for image assets, where necessary. The in-game music is entirely generated by code -- it is dynamic and reacts in real time to events happening in the game. That was also mostly Claude.

The core game was built alongside a single persistent Opus 5.5 agent in the cloud. This agent would spin up and direct other worker agents as needed. The persistent Opus 5.5 was the 'PM' for the project, keeping track of all project requirements. 

The initial prompt ran for a weekend implementing the core scaffolding. It was...extremely heavy micro. I was a bit too ambitious for what was actually fun. I then spent the next week play testing and stripping the game down to the core bits that were actually fun. 

I'd love feedback! Planning to add ranked play, more maps, and more game modes soon now that the core structure is in place and in beta.
